MOUSE_BUTTON_NONE.name: MOUSE_BUTTON_NONE
MOUSE_BUTTON_NONE.description: Enum value which doesn't correspond to any mouse button. This is used to initialize [enum MouseButton] properties with a generic state.

MOUSE_BUTTON_LEFT.name: MOUSE_BUTTON_LEFT
MOUSE_BUTTON_LEFT.description: Primary mouse button, usually assigned to the left button.

MOUSE_BUTTON_RIGHT.name: MOUSE_BUTTON_RIGHT
MOUSE_BUTTON_RIGHT.description: Secondary mouse button, usually assigned to the right button.

MOUSE_BUTTON_WHEEL_LEFT.name: MOUSE_BUTTON_WHEEL_LEFT
MOUSE_BUTTON_WHEEL_LEFT.description: Mouse wheel left button (only present on some mice).

MOUSE_BUTTON_WHEEL_RIGHT.name: MOUSE_BUTTON_WHEEL_RIGHT
MOUSE_BUTTON_WHEEL_RIGHT.description: Mouse wheel right button (only present on some mice).

MOUSE_BUTTON_XBUTTON1.name: MOUSE_BUTTON_XBUTTON1
MOUSE_BUTTON_XBUTTON1.description: Extra mouse button 1. This is sometimes present, usually to the sides of the mouse.

MOUSE_BUTTON_XBUTTON2.name: MOUSE_BUTTON_XBUTTON2
MOUSE_BUTTON_XBUTTON2.description: Extra mouse button 2. This is sometimes present, usually to the sides of the mouse.

JOY_BUTTON_A.name: JOY_BUTTON_A
JOY_BUTTON_A.description: Game controller SDL button A. Corresponds to the bottom action button: Sony Cross, Xbox A, Nintendo B.

JOY_BUTTON_B.name: JOY_BUTTON_B
JOY_BUTTON_B.description: Game controller SDL button B. Corresponds to the right action button: Sony Circle, Xbox B, Nintendo A.

JOY_BUTTON_X.name: JOY_BUTTON_X
JOY_BUTTON_X.description: Game controller SDL button X. Corresponds to the left action button: Sony Square, Xbox X, Nintendo Y.

JOY_BUTTON_Y.name: JOY_BUTTON_Y
JOY_BUTTON_Y.description: Game controller SDL button Y. Corresponds to the top action button: Sony Triangle, Xbox Y, Nintendo X.

JOY_BUTTON_BACK.name: JOY_BUTTON_BACK
JOY_BUTTON_BACK.description: Game controller SDL back button. Corresponds to the Sony Select, Xbox Back, Nintendo - button.

JOY_BUTTON_GUIDE.name: JOY_BUTTON_GUIDE
JOY_BUTTON_GUIDE.description: Game controller SDL guide button. Corresponds to the Sony PS, Xbox Home button.

JOY_BUTTON_START.name: JOY_BUTTON_START
JOY_BUTTON_START.description: Game controller SDL start button. Corresponds to the Sony Options, Xbox Menu, Nintendo + button.

JOY_BUTTON_LEFT_STICK.name: JOY_BUTTON_LEFT_STICK
JOY_BUTTON_LEFT_STICK.description: Game controller SDL left stick button. Corresponds to the Sony L3, Xbox L/LS button.

JOY_BUTTON_RIGHT_STICK.name: JOY_BUTTON_RIGHT_STICK
JOY_BUTTON_RIGHT_STICK.description: Game controller SDL right stick button. Corresponds to the Sony R3, Xbox R/RS button.

JOY_BUTTON_LEFT_SHOULDER.name: JOY_BUTTON_LEFT_SHOULDER
JOY_BUTTON_LEFT_SHOULDER.description: Game controller SDL left shoulder button. Corresponds to the Sony L1, Xbox LB button.

JOY_BUTTON_RIGHT_SHOULDER.name: JOY_BUTTON_RIGHT_SHOULDER
JOY_BUTTON_RIGHT_SHOULDER.description: Game controller SDL right shoulder button. Corresponds to the Sony R1, Xbox RB button.

JOY_BUTTON_MISC1.name: JOY_BUTTON_MISC1
JOY_BUTTON_MISC1.description: Game controller SDL miscellaneous button. Corresponds to Xbox share button, PS5 microphone button, Nintendo Switch capture button.

JOY_BUTTON_MISC2.name: JOY_BUTTON_MISC2
JOY_BUTTON_MISC2.description: Game controller SDL miscellaneous button. Used by Nintendo Switch 2 Pro Controller and Horipad Steam controllers.

JOY_BUTTON_SDL_MAX.name: JOY_BUTTON_SDL_MAX
JOY_BUTTON_SDL_MAX.description: The number of SDL game controller buttons.

JOY_BUTTON_MAX.name: JOY_BUTTON_MAX
JOY_BUTTON_MAX.description:
The maximum number of game controller buttons supported by the engine. The actual limit may be lower on specific platforms:
			- [b]Android:[/b] Up to 36 buttons.
			- [b]Linux:[/b] Up to 80 buttons.
			- [b]Windows[/b] and [b]macOS:[/b] Up to 128 buttons.

JOY_AXIS_SDL_MAX.name: JOY_AXIS_SDL_MAX
JOY_AXIS_SDL_MAX.description: The number of SDL game controller axes.

JOY_AXIS_MAX.name: JOY_AXIS_MAX
JOY_AXIS_MAX.description: The maximum number of game controller axes: OpenVR supports up to 5 Joysticks making a total of 10 axes.
